identifier_mapping.rule: Map exact source gene symbols only when the GENCODE v26 gene symbol resolves to exactly one versionless Ensembl gene ID; exclude unmapped and ambiguous symbols without alias substitution

enrichment.selected_genes: HIGH_CONFIDENCE_CONVERGENT_GENE rows grouped by atlas locus
enrichment.background: All exact uniquely mapped GENCODE v26 genes present in at least one eligible gene set in the tested resource
enrichment.null_rows: Retain every eligible set for each tested locus, including overlap=0 and P=1, so the full multiple-testing family is auditable
enrichment.multiple_testing: BH FDR within each resource and locus in the interpretation collator

REACTOME.rule: Use the human R-HSA pathway ID and name from the single official GMT member; deduplicate symbols within each pathway and apply the locked exact GENCODE mapping and set-size filter

GO.rule: Use human UniProt GAF symbols, exclude NOT rows, retain all released evidence codes, propagate annotations through is_a and part_of in the matching go-basic DAG, then apply the locked exact GENCODE mapping and set-size filter

claim_limit: Pathway overrepresentation is a competitive annotation of a prespecified convergent-gene list; it does not establish pathway activity, direction, mediation, or causality
